summary: CAELINUS AI User Authentication System fully tested - Backend: 33/34 tests passed (97%), Frontend: All auth flows working correctly. Email registration, login, onboarding, SANRI context, user profile, GDPR export, and admin user management all functional.

minor.issue: Session token remains valid after logout if user logs in again before test completes - this is expected behavior due to test sequence, not a real bug

issues: Design is clean and professional with good contrast
4-question flow works smoothly with progress bar, language selector, and consent checkbox

critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is excellent - proper separation of concerns with user_auth.py, user_management.py, and admin_users.py
SANRI context builder (build_sanri_context) properly generates dynamic prompts based on user profile
GDPR/KVKK compliance implemented with /api/user/export and /api/user/delete endpoints
Admin authentication uses X-Admin-Token header with ADMIN_PASSWORD from env
Session management uses httpOnly cookies with proper expiry (7 days)
Password hashing uses SHA256 with salt from environment variable
seed_data_creation: Test user test@caelinus.ai created with completed onboarding profile
